params.body:
The share's reading page (#399) read like a settings screen: a narrow column of small type with hairline rules, and a forty-page brief in it felt cramped. This gives a document what a document gets: a measure of about eighty characters at 18px, the title and section headings in the house serif with room above them, a lead paragraph, tables ruled rather than boxed and wide enough to read a comparison across a row. Tokens from base.css only; nothing boxed, nothing new in colour. The owner's form side is unchanged.
